about_the_game:
RED OATH: The Forsaken One

Are you ready to keep your oath in a dark and decaying world?

RED OATH: The Forsaken One is a ruthless third-person action game that invites you to the heart of a cursed and decaying realm. As the last warrior bound by an ancient oath, you will find yourself in the ruins of a shattered kingdom. Death awaits around every corner, and your only hope is to find the strength needed to break the cycle. In this world, every victory demands a price, and every mistake offers a lesson.

Armed with only your sword and shield, you must unravel the secrets of these cursed lands and face the terrifying fate that awaits you.

Key Features

  • A Challenging and Punishing Combat System: Every attack, defense, and parry comes with a cost. Learn enemy movements, manage your stamina, and approach every encounter as a struggle for survival. Victory belongs only to the most determined.

  • A Vast and Atmospheric World: Explore an interconnected, mysterious, and perilous world. From forgotten dungeons to ruined castles and shadowy forests, every area is filled with secrets and deadly foes waiting for you.

  • Epic Boss Battles: Face off against the gigantic and horrifying bosses that await you at the end of your path. Each boss will test your strategy and push the limits of your patience with unique abilities and attack patterns.

  • Mysterious Storytelling: The game's narrative is told through environmental details, item descriptions, and brief dialogues. Piece together the clues around you to uncover the truth behind the catastrophe that befell this world.

If you have the courage, step into this cycle to keep your oath.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains frequent and intense depictions of mature themes and violence. Please be aware of the following content:

Violence & Gore:
The core gameplay revolves around challenging, brutal melee combat against various monstrous creatures and humanoid foes. Players will frequently encounter scenes of intense combat with realistic sound effects and visual feedback, including blood splatters and pools of blood. Finishing moves may include depictions of dismemberment. The game world is dark and grim, featuring environmental details such as mutilated bodies, skeletal remains, and scenes of torture.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen 3 1300X or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
